translation_en: ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us: Ma‘mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah, from ‘A’ishah, who said: The Abyssinians were playing with their spears, and the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, screened me while I watched. I kept watching until I was the one who turned away. So consider what allowance should be made for a young girl who likes to watch entertainment.
